en: Color postcard showing the Church of Cozia Monastery with striped brick-and-stone walls, a domed roof with a cross, gardens in the foreground and forested mountains behind. The reverse has a Romanian 40 BANI POSTA ROMANA stamp canceled in Călimănești, Vâlcea, printed caption about the Cozia Monastery in multiple languages, publisher details, and a handwritten greeting and Bucharest address.
